post.summary:
Commenters and up: say something in the board's chat, which everyone on the board reads live from its document.
With `answer`, the model then answers in the chat too, as this person (their role, their selection).

put.summary: Updaters and owners: open a round of dot voting (clearing the last), or close it to show the results.

post.summary: Commenters and up, while a vote runs: add a vote to a note, or take one back. 409 when out of votes.

put.summary: Updaters and owners: start the board's shared timer, or stop it.

post.summary: Updaters and owners: split everyone with the board open across these frames, each group with its own timer.

delete.summary: Updaters and owners: bring everyone back together.

post.summary: Commenters and up: move yourself into a breakout group.

put.summary: Updaters and owners: start or stop one group's timer.

post.summary: Updaters and owners: take the facilitator's seat (owners can take it from someone).
The facilitator: bring everyone's view to this.

put.summary: Updaters and owners: the session's agenda, a step at a time, each with its time and frame.

post.summary: The facilitator: go to a step (its timer starts, everyone goes to its frame), or end the agenda.
Updaters and owners: start a poll (a question with options, or a fist-to-five), clearing the last one.

put.summary: Updaters and owners: close the poll to show its result, or clear it away.

post.summary: Commenters and up, while a poll is open: answer it, or change an answer.

put.summary: The facilitator: private mode on or off (pointers, selections and names hidden).

get.summary:
Updaters and owners: who has taken part in the session (since the agenda started, or the last 3 hours) and which
frames nobody has looked at. Anonymous notes and feedback participants are only counted; in private mode nobody is
named.

post.summary: Anyone on the board: frames they've had in view for a few seconds, for the facilitator's participation view.

get.summary: The workspace's folders, by name.

post.summary: Updaters and owners of the workspace: a new folder.

put.summary: Updaters and owners of the board: file it in a folder, or take it out (null).

get.summary: Whoever the workspace's policy lets manage links (board owners by default): the board's share links, newest first.

post.summary:
A link that lets anyone who has it view the board, read-only unless it lets them edit. The workspace's policies
decide who may, whether it may be editable, whether it needs a password and how soon it must expire.

Whoever may make share links: a read-only link without a password to embed the board in Notion, Confluence and
the like (the one already made, while it's live). Its page is /embed/{token}; GET /oembed describes it.

delete.summary: Board owners (and whoever the policy lets manage links): turn a link off; anyone viewing through it is let go.

parameters.name: x-link-pass
parameters.description: Proof of the link's password, from unlock

get.summary: Anyone with a link: a file on the board it opens, while the link is live (410 after).

parameters.name: x-link-pass
parameters.description: Proof of the link's password, from unlock

get.summary:
Anyone with a link: what it opens. 410 once it's turned off or expired; 403 with `passwordRequired` until the
link's password has been typed (send the pass from unlock).

An embedded board's page: what the link shows. 410 once it's turned off or expired; 403 naming the policy when the
workspace turns embeds off or the link has a password.

post.summary: Anyone with a link that has a password: type it. 403 when it's wrong; 429 after too many wrong tries.

get.summary: The team: the board's feedback link and who has joined through it, by name.

post.summary: Owners and the facilitator: open the board for feedback from anyone signed in with the link, replacing any link.

put.summary: Owners and the facilitator: change what participants see of each other.

delete.summary: Owners and the facilitator: close the board to feedback; the link stops working.

put.summary: Owners and the facilitator: keep a participant out, or let them back.

post.summary: Anyone signed in, with the link: join the board as a participant. 410 once the link is off; 403 if blocked.
A participant: add a note. The team sees it by their name.

patch.summary: A participant: change one of their own notes.

delete.summary: A participant: remove one of their own notes.

get.summary: A participant: the comments they may see, attributed as the board allows.

post.summary: A participant: comment on a note or frame they can see.
Frames this participant has had in view for a few seconds: counted for the facilitator, never by who.

get.summary:
Anyone on the board: what happened on it, newest first; only after `since` (epoch ms) when given. Who wrote an
anonymous note shows only to owners.
Anyone on the board: its saved versions, newest first.

post.summary: Updaters and owners: save the board as it is now.

get.summary: Anyone on the board: a version's content (a Yjs update), to look at before restoring it.

post.summary: Updaters and owners: bring a version back for everyone. What's there now is saved first; its id undoes this.

get.summary:
Anyone on the board (as for its versions): the points in its history replay can show, oldest first, what people
did meanwhile, and where "this session" starts.
Anyone on the board: the board at up to 30 consecutive points from `from` on, to step through.

A live stream (server-sent events) that says "changed" the moment you have a new notification; fetch the list
then. A "ping" every 25 seconds keeps proxies from closing it.
Your latest notifications, newest first.

post.summary: Marks some (or all) of your notifications read.

get.summary: Whether the development picker is on, so the sign-in page knows what to offer.

post.summary: Signing up, step one: the options for the browser to make a passkey with.
Signing up, step two: the new passkey. Makes the account and signs in.
Signing in, step one: a challenge for any of this site's passkeys.
Signing in, step two: the passkey's signature.
Ends this browser's session.

get.summary: Your passkeys.

post.summary: Adding a passkey on another device, step one.
Adding a passkey, step two.

delete.summary: Removes one of your passkeys (not the last).

post.summary: Updaters and owners: add an image or file (up to 10 MB) to the board; place it with the returned id.

get.summary: Anyone who can open the board: the file itself. Images and PDFs open in place; other files download.

post.summary: Commenters and up: ask one of the workspace's models about an image on the board, and places marked on it.
Commenters and up: react to a note or frame with one of a few emoji, or take it back.
Commenters and up: has a model summarise the board, saved in the board for everyone. 502 when the model fails.
Commenters and up: what others did on the board since `since`, summed up by a model. Not saved.
Commenters and up: a model writes the session's decisions, actions and open questions, posted to the board's chat.
Updaters and owners: start a hidden writing round. 409 if one is running.

delete.summary: Updaters and owners: end the round without revealing; its notes are thrown away.

post.summary: Updaters and owners: put every note from the round on the board, and end it.

get.summary: Commenters and up: your notes in the running round. Nobody else's.

post.summary: Commenters and up, while a round runs: write a hidden note.
Updaters and owners: start a round of planning poker on a task, a note or a title, clearing the last one.

delete.summary: Updaters and owners: put planning poker away.

post.summary: Commenters and up, until the estimates are revealed: your estimate, replacing any you gave before.

get.summary: Commenters and up: your estimate in the running round. Nobody else's until they're revealed.

put.summary: Updaters and owners: show everyone's estimates at once.

get.summary: Everyone in the workspace: the templates its people saved from their boards, newest first.

post.summary: Updaters and owners: save this board as a template for the workspace (its frames, notes, text, shapes, tables, views, arrows and agenda).

delete.summary: Whoever saved it, or the workspace's owners: delete a saved template. Boards made from it keep what they have.

post.summary: Anyone signed in: the title, description and picture of a public web page, for a link card.
Anyone signed in: a picture from a public https address, for a diagram.
Anyone with a link: a picture that a diagram on the board it opens shows, while the link is live (410 after).

get.summary: Anyone in the workspace: its issue trackers (never their tokens).

post.summary: Workspace owners: connect GitHub, Linear or Jira.

Workspace owners: a new secret for the tracker to sign its webhooks with, and where to send them. Shown this once;
any earlier secret stops working. Webhooks only bring syncs forward: linked tasks are checked on a schedule anyway.

get.summary: Anyone who can open the board: when each task sent to a tracker was last synced with its issue, and any tracker failing.

post.summary: Updaters and owners: sync the board's linked tasks with their issues now (title, status, assignee, both ways).
Updaters and owners: send the board's open tasks (or these) to a tracker; each remembers its issue.

get.summary: Workspace owners: the last 30 days, board by board, and what the models cost.
Workspace owners: everything in the workspace as one JSON file to download (never keys or tokens).

Workspace owners: the audit log, every board's history oldest first (after `since`, epoch ms): who really did
what, by id, name and email, including what was anonymous on a board and people from outside the workspace.

delete.summary: Workspace owners: delete the workspace and everything in it, typing its name to confirm.

post.summary: Updaters and owners: take back one of the model's changes (see the board's `ledger`). 409 if it's already undone.
Updaters and owners: put an undone change back. 409 if it isn't undone.

get.summary: Every comment thread on the board, resolved ones included.

post.summary: Commenters and up: comment on a note or frame. Returns its thread.

patch.summary: Commenters and up: resolve a thread, or reopen it.

delete.summary: Its author, or a board owner: delete a comment.

get.summary: Ready when Postgres answers.

post.summary: Adds someone to pick; their id is then their bearer token.

get.summary: The workspace's boards the person can open, most recently changed first.

post.summary: Updaters and owners of the workspace: a new board, blank or from a template, which they own.

get.summary: The boards a new one can start from.

post.summary:
Updaters and owners: the next session's board. It has the same frames, the tasks not yet done, and their notes; it
goes in the same workspace and folder, owned by whoever started it.

delete.summary: Board owners: delete the board, for everyone.

get.summary: Who's in the board's workspace and what each may do on this board.

put.summary: Board owners: give someone a role on this board, or (null) return them to their workspace role.

get.summary: The board's content as last saved, read-only: editing happens over the collaboration socket (/collab).
Boards in the workspace whose title or notes match the query, leaving out any kept from the person.
Everyone in the workspace, and the invites waiting to be accepted.

patch.summary: Owners: change someone's role. The last owner can't step down.

delete.summary: Owners: remove someone. Anyone: leave (their own id). The last owner can't go.

post.summary: Admins: invite an email at a role. Send them the link (/invite/{token}); it's how they join.
What an invite link is for. A POST, so the secret stays out of URLs and logs.
Joins a workspace through an invite link.

get.summary: Invites waiting for the signed-in person (development picker only; see MembersService).

post.summary: Anyone signed in: start a workspace of their own, which they own. Invite people to it from its members.

get.summary: The models this workspace's people can use.
Workspace owners: every model the site offers, and whether this workspace uses it.

put.summary: Workspace owners: let this workspace's people use one of the site's models, or stop.

get.summary: Every AI connection the site has.

post.summary: Connect a model; workspaces' owners can then switch it on.

delete.summary: Remove a connection; every workspace that used it loses it.

post.summary: Check the connection works, with a one-word reply.

put.summary: Set the search service and its key (kept encrypted, never shown again).

get.summary: What the workspace's assistant may use beyond the board.

put.summary: Owners: switch web search on or off, and set its service and key.

post.summary: Updaters and owners: make one of the model's suggestions (see the board's `suggestions`). 409 if it's gone.
Updaters and owners: turn one down. 409 if it's gone.

get.summary: A mini-app on the board (see its `app` items) and its versions.
One version's code.

post.summary: Updaters and owners: bring an earlier version back, as a new version.

Asks one of the workspace's models about the board (or the selected notes), letting it add and recolour notes.
Answers 502 with the model's problem in plain words when the model fails.

get.summary: Your tokens, newest first, without the tokens themselves.

post.summary: A new token for an agent. The response is the only time `token` is shown.

delete.summary: Stops a token working, at once.

get.summary: Scope boards:read. The boards the token's owner can open, in all their workspaces, most recently changed first.
Scope boards:read. A board as an outline: frames with their notes, other notes, everything else by kind, and tasks.
Scope boards:read. Boards whose title or notes match, best first, with matching passages.

post.summary:
Scope boards:propose. Proposes changes as one suggestion on the board, attributed "<token name> for <owner>"; nothing
changes until an updater or owner accepts it. The token's owner must be an updater or owner of the board.
Scope comments:write. Comments on a note, frame or other item, as its owner via the agent. Commenters and up.

get.summary: Anyone in the workspace: its policies.

put.summary:
Workspace owners: set the workspace's policies. Share links already out there follow at once: cut short to the
longest expiry allowed, and guests on links that no longer qualify are let go (editable ones reconnect read-only).
A shorter retention prunes old history now rather than at the next daily run.

get.summary: Anyone on the board: what the workspace's policies let them do on it, with the reason for anything they can't.
Anyone in the workspace: its logo packs, for diagrams.

post.summary:
Workspace owners: add logos to a pack (made if it's new), from a vendor's own icon download. Each logo is checked
and kept as plain SVG drawing; any that isn't is refused, with why. Send a big pack in batches of up to 2 MB.

delete.summary: Workspace owners: remove a logo pack. Shapes using its logos show none.

post.summary: Add logos to a pack from the vendor's own download, in batches of up to 2 MB; `replace` on the first batch of an update.

delete.summary: Remove a pack: shapes using its logos show none.

get.summary: Anyone in the workspace: its look for diagrams (Trench Coat's when it has none of its own).

put.summary: Workspace owners: set its look. Refused, with why, unless text on every fill meets WCAG 2.2 AA in light and dark.

delete.summary: Workspace owners: go back to Trench Coat's look.

post.summary: Workspace owners: a look to start from, read off a website or built from brand colours; nothing is saved.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Only json is offered; anything else is answered 501, as oEmbed asks.

get.summary:
oEmbed (https://oembed.com) for embed pages, so Notion's /embed block, Confluence's iframe macro and the like show
the board live: a "rich" answer with an iframe. The url must be an embed page on Corkboard's own address. 404 for
any other; 403 naming the policy when the workspace turns embeds off or the link has a password; 410 once it's
turned off or expired; 501 for formats other than json.

info.title: Corkboard API
info.description: Collaborative AI whiteboard backend. Send an access token from the identity provider as a bearer token.

answer.description: Whether the model answers this message (it was @-mentioned, or the sender has it answer everything).

modelId.description: Which of the workspace's models answers; needed when `answer` is set.

noteIds.description: The sender's selected notes, for the model to focus on; without them, the whole board.

open.description: Opens a new round (clearing the last one's votes), or closes the current one.

votesEach.description: Votes each person gets in a new round.

add.description: Adds a vote, or takes one back.

seconds.description: How long, from now; null stops the timer.

label.description: What the time is for, e.g. "Add notes".

frameIds.description: A frame for each group to work in.

minutes.description: Each group's time, if they get a timer.

seconds.description: How long, from now; null stops the group's timer.

kind.description: Hidden writing, a dot vote, or a poll.

anonymous.description: Hidden writing: revealed notes carry no author's name.

votesEach.description: A vote: votes each person gets.

pollKind.description: A poll: a question with options, or fist-to-five.

options.description: A choice poll: two to eight options.

id.description: Keeps a step's place when the agenda is edited while it runs; a new step can leave it out.

seconds.description: How long it gets; 0 for no timer.

frameId.description: The frame everyone is brought to when the step starts.

activity.description: What the step runs when it starts, if anything.

step.description: The step to go to, counting from 0; null ends the session's agenda.

kind.description: A question with options, or fist-to-five: 0 to 5 fingers.

options.description: For a choice poll: two to eight options.

clear.description: Clears the poll away, rather than closing it to show its result.

answer.description: An option's index, from 0; or for fist-to-five, fingers from 0 to 5.

on.description: Hides everyone's pointers, selections and names (but the facilitator's), or shows them again.

notes.description: Notes added this session that are still on the board; never anonymous ones.

votes.description: Dot votes in this session's round.

quiet.description: How many have added nothing yet.

viewers.description: How many people had it in view for a few seconds.

contributors.description: How many people added notes in it.

notes.description: Notes added in it this session, anonymous ones too.

since.description: Where the session starts, epoch ms: when the agenda started, or 3 hours ago without one.

fromAgenda.description: Whether `since` is when the agenda started.

private.description: Private mode is on: nobody is listed, there are only totals.

people.description: Team members who were here or took part, quietest first; empty in private mode.

anonymousNotes.description: Notes from anonymous writing rounds this session.

frames.description: The board's frames, those nobody has looked at first.

frameIds.description: Frames this person has had in view for a few seconds.

folderId.description: The folder to file it in; null to take it out of its folder.

token.description: The secret part of the link: the page's URL is /shared/{token}.

canEdit.description: Whoever has it can change the board, not just look.

hasPassword.description: Guests type a password before it opens anything.

embed.description: Made for embedding the board in another tool.

canEdit.description: Let whoever has the link change the board, not just look.

expiresInDays.description: Days until it stops working; without it, it works until revoked.

password.description: Guests must type this before the link opens anything; kept only as a hash.

expiresAt.description: Epoch ms; null for no expiry.

canEdit.description: The link lets its holder change the board.

visibility.description: What participants see of each other: everyone's feedback by name, everyone's without names, or only their own.

pseudonym.description: Other participants see "Participant <pseudonym>" when names are hidden.

link.description: The live feedback link; null when the board isn't open for feedback.

name.description: Your own name, which other participants see only when the board shows names.

member.description: Already in the board's workspace: open the board itself instead.

nodeId.description: A note or frame on the board.

value.description: A card from the round's deck.
Your estimate in the running round, or null if you haven't given one.

by.description: Who saved it; null for the saves made as people edit.

beforeVersionId.description: The board as it was before this restore, saved as a version; restore it to undo.

kind.description: A snapshot kept while people edit, or a saved version.

label.description: A version's name; null for snapshots.

events.description: What happened from the first point on, oldest first.

sessionStartId.description: The point "this session" starts from: the board as it was when the last stretch of editing (or agenda) began.

update.description: A Yjs update, base64: the whole board for the first, only what changed since the one before for the rest.

picker.description: The development picker is on: people can pick who they are without signing in.

options.description: WebAuthn options as JSON, for the browser (e.g. @simplewebauthn/browser).

answer.description: The answer to the overall question.

answers.description: Answers about each mark, by its id.

nodeId.description: A note or frame on the board.

on.description: Reacts, or takes the reaction back.

modelId.description: Which of the workspace's models writes it.

sources.description: Ids of the notes it rests on.

fingerprint.description: A hash of every note's content when it was made; the board has moved on when it differs.

since.description: When they were last here (epoch ms): what others did after it.

noteIds.description: The notes it's about, to show them.

events.description: How many things others did, as the history has them.

modelId.description: Which of the workspace's models writes it.

sources.description: Ids of the notes it rests on.

owner.description: Who does it, as the board names them; absent when nobody's named.

due.description: When, as the board says it ("Friday", "next sprint"), if it does.

label.description: The note, option, finger count or estimate; or, for the agenda, the step.

count.description: How many voted, answered or estimated it; absent for agenda steps.

title.description: The poll's question, the vote's agenda step ("Dot vote" when none), what was estimated, or "Steps run".

open.description: True while the vote or poll was still open when the recap was written.

results.description: The session's votes, polls, estimates and agenda steps, with exact counts.

model.description: The model's name, and who asked.

anonymous.description: Revealed notes carry no author's name.

frameId.description: A frame to put the notes in when they're revealed; else they go beside the board's notes.

deck.description: Story points on a Fibonacci scale, or T-shirt sizes.

taskId.description: A task on the board's kanban to estimate; "Set estimate" can then write the result to it.

noteId.description: Or a note on the board.

title.description: What's being estimated, in words; the task's or note's own text when left out.

key.description: Its id in the diagram's text (a Mermaid id).

type.description: On the diagram: its kind (flowchart). On a step: its kind of step (task, decision, start…).

dir.description: On the diagram: which way it runs.

lane.description: On a step: the key of its lane.

rich.description:
The note's rich text as written, from a saved board, used instead of `text` when given: each element
`{ n: name, a?: attributes, c?: children }`, each run of text `{ t: delta }` (Yjs XmlText delta, with its marks).

text.description: A line a paragraph; `**Bold:**` at a line's start is bold.

w.description: Its size, when not the usual one.

fill.description: tint: see-through, under the notes (for Venn diagrams).

from.description: Keys of things in the layout.

start.description: The end it leaves from: none unless given.

end.description: The end it points at: an arrowhead unless given.

label.description: Words on the line, up to 200 characters.

frame.description: The key of the frame the step is about.

activity.description: What the step runs when it starts.

savedBy.description: Who saved it, if they're still around.

canDelete.description: Whether this person may delete it: whoever saved it, and the workspace's owners.

agenda.description: How a session on it runs, if the template has a plan for one.

keepNotes.description: Keep the notes' words (prompts, examples); without them only the structure is saved. Kept by default.

baseUrl.description: Jira: the site, project key, and the email the token belongs to.

doingLabel.description: GitHub: the label that marks an open issue as in progress; "in progress" if not given.

target.description: Where issues go, in words: "acme/web", "Linear team", "ENG on acme.atlassian.net".

webhook.description: Whether a webhook secret is set up, so the tracker can say when issues change.

token.description: A personal access token or API key; stored encrypted and never shown again.

path.description: The path on this API, e.g. /hooks/trackers/<id>; the tracker needs the full address.

syncedAt.description: ISO time; null until the first sync.
When it last worked (ISO), or null.

error.description: Why it last failed, while it's failing; null once it works again.

retryAt.description: While failing: when it's next tried on its own (it backs off, more each time).

taskIds.description: Which tasks; by default, every one not done and not sent before.

taskKey.description: The task's key on the board (T-3) and the issue's in the tracker.

mayExist.description:
An earlier send got no answer (or was cut off), so the issue may already exist. Once someone has checked the
tracker, sending this task again by id (taskIds) sends it; a plain export keeps holding it.

skipped.description: Tasks left out because they'd been sent before.

updatedAt.description: Epoch ms of its last change.

events.description: In the last 30 days: things done on it, people who opened it, and model tokens spent on it.

providerId.description: The connection, or null if it's since been removed.

cost.description: In the workspace's own currency units, from the prices an owner set; null without them.

actorId.description: Null once their account is gone, or for something the API did itself.

restricted.description: It was anonymous on the board (who did it shows there only to its owners).

confirm.description: The workspace's name, typed out, to be sure.

id.description: Null once their account is gone.

body.description: As written: someone picked from the mention list is "@[Name](their user id)"; show it as "@Name".

via.description: The agent that wrote it for its author, through one of their access tokens ("Cursor"); null when they wrote it themselves.

nodeId.description: The note or frame's id in the board's document (it may since have been deleted); a pin's is "<image id>@<pin id>".

anchor.description: Where a pinned comment sits on its image.

body.description: Mention someone as "@[Name](their user id)" to name that one person; a typed "@Name" works too.

anchor.description: Starting a comment pinned to a spot on an image: where. Kept from the thread's first comment.

assistantAsksFirst.description: The assistant puts its changes to them as suggestions to accept, instead of making them.

siteAdmin.description: One of Corkboard's site admins: they run the AI connections and the cloud icon library (and nothing else).

role.description: What the person asking may do on this board.

folderId.description: The workspace folder it's filed in, if any.

starred.description: Whether the person asking starred it, and when they last opened it.

continuesId.description: The board this one carries on from, if it was started as its next session.

agenda.description: How a session on it runs, if the template has a plan for one.

template.description: A template to start from (see GET /board-templates, or one the workspace saved); without one, a blank board.

title.description: The new board's title; by default the last one's, numbered up ("Sprint 13 retro").

boardRole.description: Set on this board, replacing the workspace role; null when it follows the workspace.

role.description: What they may do here; null when they can't open the board.
A role for this board only (`none` keeps them out), or null to follow their workspace role.

snippets.description: Matching passages as HTML-escaped text, with the matches wrapped in <mark>.

token.description: Goes in the link the person is sent: /invite/{token}.

priceInPerMillion.description: What the site pays per million input and output tokens, if a site admin has said.
What the site pays per million input and output tokens, if a site admin has said.

label.description: What people see in the model picker, e.g. "Claude" or "Llama on our GPU box".

baseUrl.description: Required for OpenAI-compatible servers; for Anthropic, only to go through a proxy.

apiKey.description: Stored encrypted; omit for servers that need none (a local Ollama).

priceInPerMillion.description: Prices per million tokens, for estimating spend; null clears one.
Prices per million tokens, for estimating spend; null clears one.

status.description: What the test found: it works, or which part is at fault.

message.description: The model's reply, or what went wrong.

key.description: The service's API key, stored encrypted; leave it out to keep the one there is, or send "" to remove it.

webSearch.description: The assistant may search the web and read public pages.

searchAvailable.description: Whether the site has a search service for web search (its site admins set it).

miniApps.description: The assistant may make mini-apps on the workspace's boards.

model.description: The model that wrote it, if one did.
The model that wrote it, if one did.

suggested.description: Only suggested so far ("ask me first"): it joins the app's versions if the suggestion is accepted.

modelId.description: Which of the workspace's models to ask.

instruction.description: What the person wants: a question about the board, or something to do on it.

noteIds.description: Notes to focus on (a selection); without them, the whole board.

propose.description: Put the model's changes to the person as a suggestion instead of making them; by default, as their "ask first" setting says.

history.description: The conversation so far, oldest first, without this message; for follow-up questions.

reply.description: The model's answer, for the person who asked.

framesAdded.description: Frames the model made, to group notes or hold action items.

notesMoved.description: Existing notes the model moved into frames.

citedNoteIds.description: Notes the answer is about, most relevant first, for the person to find on the board.

citedFiles.description: The board's files the answer drew on.

citedPages.description: The web pages the answer drew on.

suggestionId.description: When the model's changes were put as a suggestion (see the board's `suggestions`) instead of made: its id.

name.description: What you called it; boards name the agent by it ("Cursor for Ada").

prefix.description: The token's first characters, to tell it apart: "cbp_AbCd1234".

expiresAt.description: Epoch ms; null when it never expires.

lastUsedAt.description: Epoch ms; null when it's never been used. Updated at most once a minute.

name.description: What to call it, usually the agent that will use it: "Cursor", "Claude Code".

expiresInDays.description: Days until it stops working; without it, it works until revoked.

name.description: What you called it; boards name the agent by it ("Cursor for Ada").

prefix.description: The token's first characters, to tell it apart: "cbp_AbCd1234".

expiresAt.description: Epoch ms; null when it never expires.

lastUsedAt.description: Epoch ms; null when it's never been used. Updated at most once a minute.

token.description: The token, "cbp_…". Shown once; only its hash is kept.

role.description: The owner's role on it: readers can read, commenters also comment, updaters and owners also propose changes.

votes.description: Dot votes, when it has any.

notes.description: The notes inside it, top to bottom, left to right.

assignee.description: The person it's assigned to, by name.

canPropose.description: Whether the token's owner may propose changes here (updaters and owners).

pendingSuggestions.description: Suggestions waiting for someone to accept or turn down.

truncated.description: True when the board had more notes than an outline holds (1000), and the rest were left out.

frameId.description: An existing frame to put it in (an id from the outline); without it, the note goes beside the board.

noteIds.description: Existing notes to move into it, by id.

notes.description: New notes to write in it.

owner.description: A board member's name; someone who isn't one keeps their name in the title.

summary.description: Why, or what was asked, in a line: shown on the suggestion.

notes.description: New notes, beside the board or in an existing frame.

frames.description: New frames, grouping existing notes and new ones. A frame all of whose notes move into new ones is removed.

tasks.description: New tasks on the board's kanban.

diagram.description: Mermaid text for a diagram drawn beside the board, starting with its kind ("flowchart TD", "sequenceDiagram", "gantt"…).

suggestionId.description: The suggestion on the board, waiting for someone to accept or turn down.

action.description: What it would do: "Would add 4 notes."

itemId.description: The note, frame or other item to comment on (an id from the outline).

shareWithPeople.description: Who may give people in the workspace a role on a board.

shareLinks.description: Who may make, change and turn off share links.

linkMaxDays.description: Share links expire within this many days; null for no limit. Links that would outlive it are cut short.

exports.description: Who may export a board: image, PDF, Markdown, CSV, or tasks sent to a tracker.

feedback.description: Who may open a board for outside feedback; board owners includes the facilitator.

retentionDays.description: Keep board history, saved versions and the assistant's undo list this many days; null keeps them for good.

editableLinks.description: Share links may let guests edit. Off: editable links already made open read-only.

linkPassword.description: Share links need a password, which guests type to open them. On: links without one stop opening.

embeds.description: Boards can be embedded in other tools (Notion, Confluence), live and read-only. Off: embeds stop showing.

reason.description: The policy's (or role's) reason, when not allowed.

linkMaxDays.description: New share links must expire within this many days; null for no limit.

editableLinks.description: Make share links that let guests edit.

embeds.description: Embed the board elsewhere, through a read-only link without a password.

linkPassword.description: New share links need a password.

licence.description: The vendor's terms, as given with its download.

site.description: From the site's library (kept by Corkboard's site admins), rather than the workspace's own.

replace.description: Start the pack afresh from this batch (a vendor's new download): send the first batch with it, the rest without.

custom.description: Whether the workspace set its own (else this is Trench Coat's).

url.description: A public web page whose styles give the colours, font and corners.

colours.description: Brand colours, as #rrggbb, most important first.

html.description: The iframe to put in the page.

cache_age.description: Seconds a consumer may keep this answer.
